greetings.text: Bless me, you look half-starved! Sit, sit. There's a pie in the oven and tea in the pot.
Oh, hullo. Wipe your boots. Don't mind the dogs.
Come in, come in, my dears. Have you eaten? You look done in.

farewells.text: Take care of yourself, now. And mind the road.
Come back and see us again, dears. There's always a bite here.

smalltalk.text: Husband's gruff, but he's a good man, underneath it.
Mushrooms, cheese, and a pie. That's what the farm gives, and it's plenty.
My girls are afraid to go to the well alone, since the strange rider came by.
Hobbits oughtn't to be out on the roads these days. But there, who listens to me?

maggot_dogs_and_rider.text: Black as a hole in the night, he was, and the dogs fair frantic. The girls haven't stopped shaking.

strange_folk_on_east_road.text: Strange folk? Aye, there's strange folk everywhere, if you ask me. Dwarves and worse.
